models.mechanism: The stage-0 press now has an affected subject and an adverse balance: successive time presses human existence into an observable return, but the return is deficiency rather than gain. The packet supplies the oath, the human located in loss, and press/yield/trade images; I infer that temporal pressure audits or consumes human capital.

activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies successive accounting or testing intervals
supplies the extracting test applied across those intervals
supplies the expected return against which loss is diagnosed
supplies the generic subject exposed to the temporal test
makes the extracted balance perceptible rather than latent
frames the condition as capital spent without adequate return

structural_cues: The oath وَٱلْعَصْرِ is followed by the emphatic إِنَّ ... لَـ assertion, tightly linking time as witness to the diagnosis.
The generic definite ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ supplies the pressed or audited subject.
The preposition فِى locates that subject inside loss rather than merely attributing an occasional loss.

abductive_moves.assumption: The oath by time points to a process that reveals the following diagnosis.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The grammatical sequence links time and human loss as evidence and conclusion, but it does not explicitly say that time causes or exposes the loss.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies time-oath → emphatic human-in-loss assertion; I infer repeated time → disclosure of the human balance.
alternatives: Time may merely witness an independently caused loss.
The oath may honor a time-period without making it an audit mechanism.

abductive_moves.assumption: Human existence can be treated as capital whose temporal yield is being measured.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: ع ص ر/B007 and خ س ر/B002 provide gain and trade-loss poles, but the packet does not state an account or investment.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies extracted yield and trade loss; I infer expenditure through time → inadequate return → net depletion.
alternatives: خسر may indicate only general deficiency.
The extracted-yield branch may be inactive here.

changed_reading.before: Time was an unspecified press that extracted whatever things contained.
changed_reading.after: Time is an audit-like press that exposes human existence as spending capital without extracting an adequate return.

minimal_triggers: ع ص ر/B007 paired with خ س ر/B002
models.ablation: Remove 103:2 or خ س ر/B002 and this falls back to the generic stage-0 press; remove ع ص ر/B002 and the context still links time to loss but no longer as extraction.

models.mechanism: The stage-0 shelter is inverted into confinement. فِى supplies an explicit container, but its interior is loss: recurring time becomes the duration or retaining shell within which the human remains under a deficient measure, not a husk carrying growth toward maturity.

activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies the recurring duration of confinement
supplies the retaining action that keeps the occupant from escaping the condition
supplies the enclosure topology, now stripped of its protective stage-0 valence
supplies the occupant of the enclosure
supplies the condition filling the enclosure
turns confinement into repeated exposure to an underfilled allotment

structural_cues: The literal spatial construction لَفِى خُسْرٍ places the human within loss and decisively activates container geometry.
The oath precedes this emphatic containment statement, making recurring time relevant to the state.
The new verse supplies loss rather than any maturation term, reversing the stage-0 enclosure's outcome.

abductive_moves.assumption: Oath-linked time maintains or deepens the containment expressed by فِى.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet explicitly places the human inside loss, but the grammatical link makes time evidence for that state, not necessarily its enclosing cause.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies recurring time and human-in-loss; I infer each temporal recurrence → continued retention in the deficient state.
alternatives: Loss itself, not time, may be the only container.
Time may witness rather than sustain the condition.

abductive_moves.assumption: The short-measure branch recurs across units of time.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: خ س ر/B003 supplies under-measurement and ع ص ر/B001 supplies recurrence, but their iteration is unstated.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: The packet supplies recurring intervals plus deficient measure; I infer repeated short measure → cumulative confinement in deficiency.
alternatives: خسر may be undifferentiated loss with no measuring process.
The enclosure image may be purely spatial rather than cumulative.

changed_reading.before: Time was a sheltering enclosure that preserved growth until maturity.
changed_reading.after: Time is the recurring retaining enclosure within which the human remains in a short-measured, diminishing condition.

minimal_triggers: ع ص ر/B001, B006, and B010
models.ablation: Remove فِى and the enclosure reversal collapses; remove ع ص ر/B006 and B010 and the result becomes only a generic oath linking time to loss.

surprise_reading: With 103:2, “By al-ʿaṣr” is no longer neutral duration: it can name the press or audit through which human capital shows a deficient return, or the recurring enclosure that keeps the human inside an underfilled condition. The latter reverses my stage-0 image of time as shelter.
